Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_add_on_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_sep_ind number(1);
 
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_freeze_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time');
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.third_sep');
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.second_sep');
 default_value('111111111111111','GLOBAL.max_bleed_time');
 default_value('111111111111111','GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time');
 if :GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time = 'N'
 then
 -- this is to avoid database access repeatedly for
 -- same reason
 begin
 select max_bleed_time,
 slow_bleed_time
 into :GLOBAL.max_bleed_time,
 :GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 :GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time := 'Y';
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 -- to check if the bag code
 select first_sep_weight, second_sep_weight
 into :GLOBAL.first_sep_weight, :GLOBAL.second_sep_weight
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0084');
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 begin
 select thaw_method, thaw_temperature,
 dummy_product_code, actual_product_code,
 freeze_time, cryo_ok_flag, sep_ind
 into :thaw_method, :thaw_temperature,
 :old_product_code, :new_product_code,
 --MS :freeze_time, 
 v_freeze_time, --MS
 :cryo_ok_flag, temp_sep_ind
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);

 --MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if v_freeze_time is not null then
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, v_freeze_time, v_local_time);
 :freeze_time := v_local_time;
 else
 :freeze_time := v_freeze_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 --MS 
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('0186');
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select method_desc
 into :method_desc
 from valid_cryo_methods
 where thaw_method = :thaw_method
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if temp_sep_ind = 3
 then
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'N';
 begin
 select third_sep_weight, third_sep_centrifuge_id,
 third_sep_time
 into :sep_weight, :centrifuge_id, :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 elsif temp_sep_ind = 2
 then
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'N';
 begin
 select second_sep_weight,
 second_sep_centrifuge_id,
 second_sep_time
 into :sep_weight, :centrifuge_id,
 :sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id 
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) 
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and reject_reason_code is null
 and SUBSTR(components.product_code,1,5) =
 valid_products.product_code and
 product_type = 'CRYO';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0131');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
end;

Item.Name: SEP_WEIGHT
Item.Hint: Enter plasma weight after CRYO separation

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_diff_weight number(5,2);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :sep_weight not between 1 and 400
 then
 show_error('0250');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y'
 then
 if :sep_weight >= to_number(:GLOBAL.first_sep_weight)
 then
 show_error('0240');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 temp_diff_weight := to_number(:GLOBAL.first_sep_weight) -
 :sep_weight;
 if :sep_weight + temp_diff_weight
 > to_number(:GLOBAL.first_sep_weight)
 then
 show_error('0240');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.third_sep = 'Y'
 then
 if :sep_weight >= to_number(:GLOBAL.second_sep_weight)
 then
 show_error('0240');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 temp_diff_weight := to_number(:GLOBAL.second_sep_weight) -
 :sep_weight;
 if to_number(:GLOBAL.second_sep_weight) + temp_diff_weight
 > to_number(:GLOBAL.first_sep_weight)
 then
 show_error('0240');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

declare

begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;

--MS
 if :freeze_time is not null then
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :freeze_time, v_gmt_time); 
 :global.freeze_time := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');

 show_error('0058');
 check_package_Failure;
 END IF;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INTERDICTION_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure interdiction_check(temp_inter_code IN VARCHAR2,
 temp_count OUT number) is
begin
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and product_code = :new_product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = temp_inter_code
 and inter_code =
 component_interdictions.inter_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date, sysdate+365));
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_interdiction(temp_inter_code IN VARCHAR2) is
 temp_count number;
 tmp_inter_code VARCHAR2(8);
begin
 tmp_inter_code := temp_inter_code;
 interdiction_check(tmp_inter_code, temp_count);
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 begin
 show_error('9790', ': '||temp_inter_code); 
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id , :new_product_code,
 inter_code , sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = temp_inter_code
 and inter_code not in (select inter_code
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and product_code =
 :new_product_code)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('6');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DELETE_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure delete_interdiction(temp_inter_code IN VARCHAR2) is
 temp_count number;
 tmp_inter_code VARCHAR2(8);
begin
 tmp_inter_code := temp_inter_code;
 interdiction_check(tmp_inter_code, temp_count);
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 begin
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and product_code = :new_product_code
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where inter_code =
 component_interdictions.inter_code
 and system_inter_code = temp_inter_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('7');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRE_COMMIT_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure pre_commit_data is
 temp_max_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_ws number(10,2);
 temp_max_ws number(10,2);
 temp_min_frz number(10,2);
 temp_max_frz number(10,2);
 temp_ws_date date;
 temp_ws_time number(10,2);
 temp_frz_time number(10,2);
 current_dats date; 
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 --Update centrifuge ID in units
 begin
 current_dats := sysdate;
 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y' then
 update units
 set second_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id
 where unit_id = :unit_id 
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 elsif :GLOBAL.third_sep = 'Y' then
 update units
 set third_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 --Check for four interdictions CRTE, CRWS, CRSE, CRYO
 begin
 select max_temp, min_ws_freeze_time, 
 max_ws_freeze_time, min_sep_freeze_time,
 max_sep_freeze_time
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_ws,
 temp_max_ws, temp_min_frz,
 temp_max_frz
 from valid_cryo_methods 
 where thaw_method = :ctrl_blk_1.thaw_method
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 temp_min_ws := (trunc(temp_min_ws) * 60) + (((temp_min_ws - trunc(temp_min_ws))*100)) ;
 temp_max_ws := (trunc(temp_max_ws) * 60) + (((temp_max_ws - trunc(temp_max_ws))*100));
 temp_min_frz := (trunc(temp_min_frz) * 60) + (((temp_min_frz - trunc(temp_min_frz))*100)) ;
 temp_max_frz := (trunc(temp_max_frz) * 60) + (((temp_max_frz - trunc(temp_max_frz))*100)); 
 --message(to_char(temp_min_ws) || ' ' || to_char(temp_max_ws) || ' ' || to_char(temp_min_frz)|| ' ' || to_char(temp_max_frz)) ;
 --1) CRTE -- Pick max temp from valid_cryo_methods
 if :ctrl_blk_1.thaw_temperature > temp_max_temp then 
 insert_interdiction('CRTE');
 else
 delete_interdiction('CRTE');
 end if; 
 --2) CRWS -- Compare freeze time and worksheet ID
 BEGIN
 select max(insert_dats) into temp_ws_date 
 from cryo_units 
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 handle_error;
 END;
 
 --MS temp_ws_time := 24 * 60 *(:freeze_time - temp_ws_date);
 temp_ws_time := 24 * 60 *(to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') - temp_ws_date); --MS
 
 If temp_ws_time not between temp_min_ws and temp_max_ws
 then
 insert_interdiction('CRWS');
 else
 delete_interdiction('CRWS');
 end if;
 --3) CRSE --Compare last seperation with Freeze
 temp_frz_time := 24 * 60 *(to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') - :sep_time);
 If temp_frz_time not between temp_min_frz and temp_max_frz
 then
 insert_interdiction('CRSE');
 else
 delete_interdiction('CRSE');
 end if;
 -- 4) CRYO --Cryo OK Flag
 If :cryo_ok_flag = 'N' then
 insert_interdiction('CRYO');
 else
 delete_interdiction('CRYO');
 end if;
 begin
 update cryo_units
 set thaw_method = :thaw_method,
 thaw_temperature = :thaw_temperature,
 sep_ind = to_number(
 decode(:GLOBAL.second_sep,'Y','2',
 'N','3')),
 --MS freeze_time = :freeze_time,
 freeze_time = to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'), --MS
 cryo_ok_flag = :cryo_ok_flag,
 reject_reason_code = decode(:cryo_ok_flag,'Y','',
 'N','CRYO')
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update components
 set bag_id = :ctrl_blk_1.catalog_number,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in updating components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 BEGIN
 update component_cgmp
 set process_dats = to_date(:global.freeze_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') --MS :freeze_time
 where unit_id =:unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and parm_code = 'FRZ'
 and parm_value = 'A' ;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in updating Component CGMP');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
end;
